gen-gf-langar-fs-rowan: Loud, expressive swagger from Langar, whose joins match its stems without any contrast. And Rowan, a friendly serif with generous curves, would feel literary across pages, though brief text suits it best.
gen-gf-lemon-fs-paquito: Lemon is bold, with a near-circular c and barely heavier stems. Paquito, a confident text serif whose capitals sit just above its x-height, feels approachable and is happiest in modest doses.
gen-gf-lemonada-fs-karma: Karma reads trustworthy and classic, its terminals finishing well away from the stem and its curves thickening gently. And Lemonada, drawn with pencil-line consistency and no modulation, gives that gentle text a commanding partner.
gen-gf-lemonada-fs-paquito: Tight, unwavering lines: Lemonada never swells or thins, and it commands attention at the top. Paquito, confident and approachable, is the one to read, though it does better when text stays brief.
gen-gf-libertinus-keyboard-fs-paquito: Confident and approachable, this serif text sits low against the towering lowercase of Libertinus Keyboard. Paquito would stay friendly across a page of text, though it's better kept short.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-amulya: Liu Jian Mao Cao traces each glyph in one stroke width, casual and tightly packed. And Amulya, comfortable in modest amounts, lets that crowded handwriting breathe, the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-bespoke-sans: Relaxed in mood, Liu Jian Mao Cao draws stems and arches in identical thickness, with its letters packed tightly together. Handwriting brings the personality; Bespoke Sans brings refined, brief-reading sharpness.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-literata: Literata reads sophisticated and bookish, with subtle but visible stroke modulation and open-mouthed curves, comfortable in modest amounts. Liu Jian Mao Cao gives signage-plain, casual headings; Literata handles the reading.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-neco: Liu Jian Mao Cao holds a unit-width stroke throughout, in casual, relaxed letters squeezed tightly together. Neco, dignified and authoritative, is better held to a few sentences than pages.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-plein: Relaxed Liu Jian Mao Cao draws each n with matching arch and stem. The clear channel Plein cuts into every round letter is the pair's best quality, better kept to a line or two.
